description: Option D: the c_3 front's deliverable as a measurement budget. Every c_3 claim is gated by sigma(Q_beta) amplified by dc_3/dQ_beta = 1/(Q_N2 u^3) ~ 2.07e6 per MeV, giving sigma(c_3) = +/-1.26 against |c_3| ~ 2.02 — a 62%-uncertain target. Makes the ask concrete two ways: (1) Q_beta is reachable both directly (CAL-3) and as m_n - m_p - m_e, and this probe computes both sigmas from committed values so the cheaper route is visible; (2) the mass-difference variance is dominated by the NEUTRON mass, so a programme not touching m_n cannot deliver the factors. Reports required sigma(Q_beta) for the zero-location test and for the c_3 ~ -Vol(4_1) comparison at each anchor. Explicitly does NOT assess experimental feasibility — outside what this repo can judge. Scope-(a); no fit, no c_k wired, no claim about (H1).
tier: error propagation on committed values (no fit)
